notes.title: 1.1.5 Update（2020.03.19）
notes.notes:
1.1.5 Update contents

"Graphic settings" and "Time settings" were only possible at the start of the game and at the start gate, but with this change you can always change them from the menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/86bfd18bcea4cf2e499ded3ea6219fda016dee34.jpg

＜Quit Game menu added＞
"Quit Game" has been added to the menu and you can now quit the game from within the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/336610dd87566ec408b2d6594942f0675e60403c.jpg

＜Feather stick＞
A feather stick is a thin, shredded, curled wood that is easily burned.
It is called a "feather stick" because it looks like feather.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/1ba64380196b5eb880bf86a7d87ffdf6a826be3c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/bf6eb21f9061b542dd64017c62dcf83ccefe49b2.jpg

・How to make it
A thin piece of curled wood is created by sliding the knife to cut firewood.
Both ends can be curled.
Note: Only when the firewood (1/8 firewood) shown below is not splitable any more,
"Feather sticks "can be made.
Other fires and branches cannot be feather stick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/b081f45fe37eb6beb0375c03116ac9e75a4e9b47.jpg

＜Gloves＞
The operation appearance has been changed from "controller" to "fire resistant gloves for bonfire".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/e3f603f654d87557a032d15ef10bd83e585e8a9b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/336610dd87566ec408b2d6594942f0675e60403c.jpg

＜Other＞
Tuned the parameters so that the firewood burns longer.
Fixed a problem with burning twigs.
Added a tutorial page for changes in the update.
Fixed the bug that the wood underneath doesn't burn.
Simplify the rendering process of burning expressions.
Changed to be able to peel bark (1/8 firewood)

notes.notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/fae30f4762cf1a46f06cfb3e4f8dd343f7c7c836.jpg

Fireblaster functionality was implemented.

＜How to use Fire Blaster＞
You can use Fire Blaster by bringing it close to your mouth.
By changing the distance between the HMD and the controller, you can change the strength of your breath.
When the gauge changes from blue to red, the supply of oxygen increases.
Note: It doesn't respond when you actually breathe into the microphone.

Others
Fixed a fire sway bug that relies on FPS.

This time, ”Feather stick" is not implemented.

notes.title: Ver1.0.2 Update available.
notes.notes:
[Ver1.0.2 Update available Now！

Update details

1. Improved operability
　-Added "Rotate" operation.
　-"Move" operation has been changed from grip button to trackpad.
　-Changed "Basic operation" in online help.
　-The holding of the ax has been changed to the optimum angle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/9951bb6917ceef5057c4e2fbcada4c5e9b5c9dc8.jpg

2. “Usability” has been improved by “optimization of hit detection”.

3. Added types and number of burnable “Firewood” and “branches”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/8cd9c510073490c9d942d8bdc9457ccfbc41126b.png

4. "Usability" has been improved by spawning "firewood" around "Bonfire stand"
　 and "branches" under the tree.

5. “Flame combustion system” parameter adjustment
　-Combustion parameters and firepower of "Igniter" have been adjusted, 
　 the combustion parameters have been changed, and the flame behavior has become
　 more realistic.

6.Reduction of "graphic processing load"
　-Reduced calculation load when "Firewood" and "Branch" are not burning.

7. Increased the flame resolution to make it more realistic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35445769/080a825d2c10d43892de218682b5674f98b95145.jpg
